descricao_original: This electron micrograph shows the irregular outline of a lysosome in the lower right corner of the image. The heterogeneous contents of the lysosome are breakdown products of recycled organelles and internalized materials. Note also the RER, ribosomes and mitochondria in this image. 30,000x
